summary.text: David DeCoste is a Republican member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 5th Plymouth District since January 2015 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: DeCoste took office on January 7, 2015, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Joint Committee on Aging and Independence and the Joint Committee on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, and served as ranking minority member of the Housing, Public Service and Transportation joint committees.
